next.reason: No 2023 CLOSE rule requires the files to share organization or access mode. Format §2023:14.9.6.2 repeats file-name-1 with per-file phrases, and §2023:14.9.6.4 GR10 makes a multi-file CLOSE 'the same as if a separate CLOSE statement had been written for each file-name-1'. SR-14.9.6.3-3 restricts only a 2023-new context (exception-checking PERFORM). Mixed CLOSEs are accepted with the same effect.
